name: Marshal's Refuge
summary: In Marshal's Refuge, expedition survivors shelter above Un'Goro Crater's dangerous basin. Williden Marshal and his party established the camp after beasts overran their lower camps.

sections.title: A Precarious Perch
sections.body: Williden and Hol'anyee Marshal led their expedition into Un'Goro Crater. Its ancient beasts proved fiercer than they expected. After the creatures overran their first camps again and again, the survivors fled to the northern cliffs. Now Marshal's Refuge clings to a cavernous ledge above the jungle floor, where weary explorers can rest, find basic supplies, and speak with flight masters.

sections.title: A Crossroads of Curiosity
sections.body: Researchers and wanderers gather at Marshal's Refuge to study Un'Goro Crater's ancient life and strange crystals. The surviving Marshal crew shares the crowded ledge with naturalists from many lands, including dwarven scholars and gnomish tinkerers. From the camp, scouts set out for Fire Plume Ridge and the Golakka Hot Springs. They hope to record the wilderness before it overwhelms them.

faq.q: Why was Marshal's Refuge built so high up the cliff?
aliases: why is it in a cave
faq.answer: Un'Goro's fierce beasts repeatedly overran the expedition's lower camps. The survivors retreated to the northern cliffs, where the rock wall gave them a defensible perch beyond the reach of larger creatures.

faq.q: Is Marshal's Refuge friendly to both Horde and Alliance?
faq.answer: Yes. Marshal's Refuge is a neutral outpost where members of both factions can mingle, resupply, and trade research.
Williden Marshal and Hol'anyee Marshal lead the encampment. They organized the Marshal Expeditions into Un'Goro Crater.

faq.q: What services are available at the Refuge?
faq.answer: The Refuge has a flight master, basic trade merchants, and repair services. Researchers also gather there to offer bounties and investigations across the crater.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can study Un'Goro's rare and deadly beasts from the Refuge's perch before heading down to track them.
As a gnome, you can use the Refuge as an outpost to test apparatus on Un'Goro's strange power crystals and volatile geysers.
